text: Advanced Model Configuration 是 DSH WebUI 插件，在设置页增加独立模型配置界面。它读取 DSH 的提供方目录与共享设置服务，可管理内置及自定义提供方、编辑模型目录和推理选项、配置端点与重试策略，并发现可用模型。适合需要在网页设置中维护多种模型路由的 DSH 用户；模型发现会使用所选提供方的配置。

Advanced Model Configuration adds model settings to DSH WebUI. Edit built-in and custom providers, model catalogs, endpoints and reasoning options, or discover models from a configured provider. Intended for users managing model routes in DSH.
我想在 DSH 网页设置里统一编辑模型提供方和模型参数。
怎么在 DSH 里添加一个自定义模型服务并填写它的接口地址？
能不能从模型服务发现模型，再挑选后加入配置目录？
我想调整 DeepSeek 模型列表，并能恢复默认目录。
How can I edit provider endpoints and model settings in the DSH web interface?
Can I add a custom model provider and discover its available models?
Advanced Model Configuration 的功能「管理内置提供方」：在设置页查看 DSH 已声明的内置提供方，并添加到用户配置；页面会依提供方目录与共享设置状态刷新。
Advanced Model Configuration 的功能「创建自定义提供方」：填写路由标识、显示名、协议、接口地址和模型目录后提交；表单先校验标识与配置，再写入共享设置。
Advanced Model Configuration 的功能「编辑官方模型目录」：编辑官方 DeepSeek 设置和模型目录；目录仍为默认值时跟随服务模型列表，恢复默认会移除自定义目录。
Advanced Model Configuration 的模型发现请求会调用当前配置的提供方接口；若请求带有用户填写的 API key，该值随请求传给该接口。

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · dsh-advanced-model-editor：A DeepSeek Harness WebUI plugin that adds an **Advanced Model Configuration** section to the
Settings page. It manages LLM provider profiles across the settings namespaces — the
custom provider namespace (`llm-pi-ai`) and the official provider namespace
(`llm-deepseek`) — including built-in and custom providers, model lists,
reasoning/thinking options, headers, retry policy and more, with the same validation
and conflict rules as the official settings UI.

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · dsh-advanced-model-editor：Reads and writes ride DSH's shared settings services (`ctx.configForms` /
`ctx.settingsSchema`), so this page and the official Models page share one document
mirror and one revision queue instead of racing each other. The section appears only
while one of its namespaces is actually served, and it shows the provider facts DSH
directory reports — the endpoint a profile inherits (`defaultBaseURL` / `baseURLEnv`),
the route's own authentication (`nativeAuth`, including OAuth) and any catalog
diagnostic — so a keyless route no longer reads as a missing credential.

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · dsh-advanced-model-editor：The official DeepSeek card also shows how its catalog relates to the service's
model listing: whether the route still follows `GET /models`, whether an edited
catalog replaced it, or whether the endpoint is not the official one at all — with
a **Restore defaults** action that clears the override and resumes the listing.

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · Requirements：- **DSH** `>= 0.2.2-rc.1` — only the current release is supported. There is no
  backward-compatibility layer for older DSH versions.
- **Node.js** `^22.19 || >=24`.

---

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · Quick Install (Recommended / One-Line)：Install directly from the GitHub `dist` branch (pre-built by CI, no manual clone or compilation required):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:u9521/dsh-advanced-model-editor#dist
```

Then **restart web** (`dsh web`) and **hard-refresh** your browser (Cmd+Shift+R). The plugin appears as **Advanced Model Configuration** in Settings.

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · Upgrade (Remote Install)：Use the `dsh plugin update` command to pull the latest dist release:

```sh
@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · upgrade to the latest dist release：dsh plugin --profile web update @local/dsh-advanced-model-editor
section: upgrade to the latest dist release

text:
@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · or re-add the dist branch：dsh plugin --profile web add github:u9521/dsh-advanced-model-editor#dist
```

Then **restart web** and **hard-refresh** your browser.

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · Prerequisites：- **pnpm installed** — `npx get-pnpm` (see https://pnpm.io/installation; alternatives:
  `corepack enable` or `npm install -g pnpm`). Required both for building and because
  `dsh plugin --profile web add` forwards to pnpm internally.
- **Node.js** `^22.19 || >=24`.

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · 1. Clone：Clone the repository into the recommended location:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/u9521/dsh-advanced-model-editor.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-advanced-model-editor
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-advanced-model-editor
```

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · 2. Build：The build output (`lib/`) is not committed to the source branch — build it yourself for local development:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build
```

`pnpm run build` runs `tsc` (type check + emit `lib/types/`) and `tsdown` (bundle
`lib/index.js` + `lib/client.js`) with the project's own dependencies — no DSH source
checkout is needed. The browser half is a self-contained closure factory for the DSH
client module table; the whole platform-module contract lives in `tsdown.config.mjs`.

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · 2. Build：Verify the build with:

```sh
pnpm test
```

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · 3. Local Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-advanced-model-editor
```

Then **restart web** (`dsh web`) and **hard-refresh** the browser (Cmd+Shift+R).

---

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · Development & Maintenance Commands：| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `pnpm run build` | Full build (runs `tsc` type check + generates `lib/` bundles) |
| `pnpm run check` | Type check only (`tsc --noEmit`) without emitting files |
| `pnpm test` | Full build, then run the test suite (`node --test`) |
| `pnpm run lint` | ESLint, type check, test suite, and Prettier check in one pass (CI gate) |
| `pnpm run lint:fix` | Apply ESLint fixes, then rewrite the files with Prettier |
| `pnpm run fmt` | Format source and config files with Prettier |
| `pnpm run fmt:check` | Check code formatting compliance |

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · Local Source Upgrade：When installed locally, the plugin is linked via `link:` into the profile. Upgrading local sources only requires **pulling the latest commit and rebuilding** — no need to re-run `dsh plugin add`:

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-advanced-model-editor
git pull
pnpm run build
```

*(If dependencies changed, run `pnpm install` before building)*

Then **restart web** (`dsh web`) and **hard-refresh** the browser (Cmd+Shift+R).

---

@local/dsh-advanced-model-editor README · Uninstall：Whether installed from GitHub or linked from local sources, uninstall with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @local/dsh-advanced-model-editor
```

Restart web and hard-refresh the browser afterwards. If local sources are no longer needed, you can delete the cloned directory:

```sh
rm -rf ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-advanced-model-editor
```
